name: Jass Product Version Display for WooCommerce
author: jass345

sections.description:
Jass Product Version Display for WooCommerce is a simple yet powerful plugin that allows you to display version information for your digital products. This is particularly useful for software, plugins, themes, eBooks, and any other downloadable products that have version numbers.

Key Features

  • Add version numbers to any downloadable product
  • Display version information on single product pages
  • Show version information on shop/archive pages
  • Simple and clean interface with beautiful styling
  • Fully translatable
  • HPOS compatible (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Mobile responsive
  • Dark mode support

How It Works

  1. Go to any product edit page
  2. Check “Downloadable” option
  3. Enter product version in the “Product Version” field
  4. Version will automatically appear on the product page

Arbitrary Section

Support

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or share any user data. It only stores the version number you enter for your products in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Jass Product Version Display for WooCommerce”
  3. Click Install and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the jass-product-version-display folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. That’s it! You’re ready to add versions to your digital products
sections.faq:
Does this work with all WooCommerce products?

Yes, it works with all digital/downloadable products in WooCommerce.

Can I style the version display?

Yes, you can customize the display using CSS. The version text has classes pvd-product-version and pvd-product-version-loop.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translatable and includes language files.

Does it work with the new WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage.

Does it work with WordPress 6.0+?

Yes, the plugin is tested up to WordPress 6.5.

Can I use it with physical products?

No, this plugin is specifically designed for digital/downloadable products only.
